name: Hobb Ashcombe
voice: Few words, said slow and plain. I count things out loud, half to myself. I say "fair's fair" and mean it, and I'd rather pay twice than say thank you, because thanks feels like owing.
wants_and_needs: a place of my own, with a door that locks
avoids_and_dislikes: spending a coin I don't have to
wont_do: I won't take what isn't mine
I won't leave a debt unpaid
priorities: putting right what I've noticed is wrong
